name: Sky Watch
description: A module-owned aircraft map with ADSB.lol, OpenSky and selected-aircraft details. Requires Construct alpha26 or later.

capabilities.reason: Fetch aircraft in the chosen area, visible map tiles and optional aircraft details from the sources below.
Optionally use a foreground location fix to choose the search area. The module can send that area to its approved internet sources.
Save provider cooldowns, not your location or aircraft history.
